title: House-sized tall white deep spacecraft seen in person

tellings.quote: see how this house is one that I personally saw was a little bit longer than this house a little bit wider than this house about half again as high as this house

plain: In the 1960s in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, a man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years near pale, tall beings he calls the Tall Whites, says he personally saw one of their deep-space craft up close. He describes it as a bit longer and wider than a house and about half again as high. Hall tells it as his own sighting, and if true it would mean such craft landed on American soil.
